title: VP at New Mexico’s Largest Newspaper Loses Job in One Walmart Trip
description:
A man and his two kids were trespassed from a Walmart in Rio Rancho, New Mexico in an alleged shoplifting scandal. Police were called to the store after two boys were allegedly acting disorderly by knocking over displays and drinking two Monster Energy drinks without paying before stashing the cans on a shelf, according to the Rio Rancho Police Department. Body Camera footage shows officers approaching the boys when they are led to their father, who was allegedly busy with his own scheme at the self-checkout register. Police said Patrick Ethridge, 47, who worked as the Executive Editor and Vice President of The Albuquerque Journal was “skip-scanning” items by passing some items through without paying. All three were led to a loss prevention area in the store where they were issued a summons for shoplifting. Ethridge, reportedly, parted ways with his job shortly after the alleged crime.
